verification.method: Decode VJB1 + VC2; bind height marker and SHA-256 bundle ID; compare identical replayed replica bytes; derive addresses using Keccak-256 first20 bytes; independently verify every Ed25519 RV1 precommit signature with OpenSSL; check distinct trusted signer quorum under Service-validated effective schedule.

rotation_votes.interpretation: A present verified commit signature proves the laptop signed the decided value at that height/round. Its absence from one quorum certificate alone does not prove it sent no vote; height7 additionally excludes its key from the committed active set.

certificate.all_signatures_independently_verified: OpenSSL 3.6.4, Ed25519 RV1 precommit bytes, Keccak-256 address derivation

proposer.evidence: Observer received proposal at certificate height/round and exact displayed value prefix; certificate itself records voters, not proposer.
